title: AMD's most important product ever - Ryzen 9 4900HS
summary: Linus Tech Tips reviews AMD's Ryzen 9 4900HS mobile CPU in the ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 laptop, calling it a landmark product. It highlights strong performance against Intel along with good efficiency and battery life.
why: HN people cite it as a review showing Zen 2's efficiency and performance advantage over Intel in laptops.

quote.text: This LTT review captures the massive advantage Zen 2 has in efficiency
